integrity: Proof is analytical and self-contained under the stated Fock-space normalization; exact rational and finite-matrix checks supplement, rather than certify, infinite-dimensional assertions. No independent mathematical validation or originality certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Local small-deformation result for fixed finite rank N>=2 and fixed positive area, smooth zero-mean angular perturbations. The formula does not prove global uniqueness, global quantitative stability, or strict positive curvature in all frequencies m>=3. Residual literature-overlap risk exists for uninspected spectral shape-derivative publications.
title: Angular Fourier Hessian of Fock Toeplitz Ky Fan sums
